rationale: Price is at 84% of today's range and near the session high ($56.63), with the last five 1-minute candles showing very tight, low-volume consolidation after a sharp intraday rally — momentum is stalling rather than accelerating. The negative earnings news (expected EPS decline, negative Earnings ESP) creates overhead fundamental resistance, and with earnings imminent the risk of a gap-reversal is elevated. The risk/reward for either direction is unclear: chasing long near the high risks a reversal into the negative news catalyst, while shorting into a 3.3x relative-volume up-move with SPY positive and VIX falling lacks a clear trigger.
